verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents two first-party ways to work in natural language. Its official MCP server connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Codex and OpenCode, and can be used with no code and no API key. Its agentic search mode has an LLM plan a free-text request into deterministic filters and sub-searches. Hands-on reports show natural-language queries handled poorly, such as "red high top sneakers under $40" returning random items and ignoring the price limit, so execution quality is uncertain. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that agentic mode reliably turns natural-language constraints into filters, and natural-language control beyond search/lookup (e.g. price-tracking subscriptions).
